### runObservationStateSchema

```ts
const runObservationStateSchema: ZodEnum<{
  requested: "requested";
  admitted: "admitted";
  running: "running";
  needs_review: "needs_review";
  completed: "completed";
  verified: "verified";
  failed: "failed";
  cancelled: "cancelled";
  unknown: "unknown";
}>;
```

Where a run stands. `completed` means the owner saw it finish without an error;
it is never verification, so `verified` is reserved for an owner that has
checked the result. `unknown` means the owner cannot say.

---

### runObservationLogSchema

```ts
const runObservationLogSchema: ZodObject<
  {
    cursor: ZodNumber;
    size: ZodNumber;
    eof: ZodBoolean;
  },
  $strict
>;
```

A position in an owner's log file. `cursor` is a byte offset the owner issued:
pass it back unchanged to read on. `size` is the bytes the owner has confirmed
present, so it is at least `cursor` and exact when `eof` is true. `eof` means
the observation read to the end of the log as it stands; a running run may write
more.

### runObservationCostSchema

```ts
const runObservationCostSchema: ZodObject<
  {
    amount: ZodNumber;
    unit: ZodString;
  },
  $strict
>;
```

What a run costs, in the owner's unit. Owners that do not meter a run report
`null`; a cost is never estimated.

### runObservationSchema

```ts
const runObservationSchema: ZodObject<
  {
    source: ZodEnum<{
      shedProcess: "shed.process";
      oysterBuild: "oyster.build";
    }>;
    id: ZodString;
    parentId: ZodOptional<ZodString>;
    sourceRevision: ZodOptional<ZodString>;
    state: ZodEnum<{
      requested: "requested";
      admitted: "admitted";
      running: "running";
      needs_review: "needs_review";
      completed: "completed";
      verified: "verified";
      failed: "failed";
      cancelled: "cancelled";
      unknown: "unknown";
    }>;
    reason: ZodOptional<ZodString>;
    requestedAt: ZodNumber;
    startedAt: ZodOptional<ZodNumber>;
    endedAt: ZodOptional<ZodNumber>;
    log: ZodNullable<
      ZodObject<
        {
          cursor: ZodNumber;
          size: ZodNumber;
          eof: ZodBoolean;
        },
        $strict
      >
    >;
    outputs: ZodArray<
      ZodObject<
        {
          kind: ZodString;
          ref: ZodString;
        },
        $strict
      >
    >;
    cost: ZodNullable<
      ZodObject<
        {
          amount: ZodNumber;
          unit: ZodString;
        },
        $strict
      >
    >;
  },
  $strict
>;
```

One run as its owner reports it. The owner maps its own records into this shape
and keeps no copy: reading it again by `id` is how a caller recovers after a
lost connection.
